title: Watch List
description: Stocks and ETFs the user is monitoring for potential investment. Current prices are NOT stored here — they are fetched live from market data at query time.

added_date.description: Date the ticker was added to the watchlist (ISO 8601)

reason.description: Why the user is watching this ticker

target_buy_price.description: Price at which the user would consider buying

target_sell_price.description: Price at which the user would consider selling (if already holding)

notes.description: Freeform user notes about this ticker

priority.description: How closely the user wants to monitor this ticker
